kitchenCycle.stale: This period changed. Refresh the current state; your draft stays here. Review it before saving again.
kitchenCycle.unknown: The result is not yet known. Your draft is retained. Retry the same operation before editing or submitting.
kitchenCycle.error: Kitchen could not complete this action.
kitchenCycle.submittedEditable: Submitted. You can still save changes until household confirmation.
kitchenCycle.saveThenSubmit: Save your choices, then submit to complete your planning Task.
kitchenCycle.saveFirst: Save the answers shown here before submitting.
kitchenCycle.noGroceries: Groceries are not tracked for this trip
kitchenCycle.acknowledgeGap: I reviewed missing ingredients or portions with no diner demand
kitchenCycle.staleProposal: This preview is out of date. Keep your draft and review a new adjustment before applying.
kitchenCycle.confirmationImpact: Confirmation publishes this period's grocery demand and creates enabled cooking Tasks. It completes household review, not shopping or purchases.
kitchenCycle.dueNow: I reviewed that responses or confirmation may become due immediately.
kitchenCycle.recoveryHint: Choose current eligible household members. This repairs this open period only; future settings stay separate.
kitchenCycle.shoppingDistinct: Complete the shopping Task when the trip is done. Check purchased items in Shopping, then transfer purchases to Pantry separately.
kitchenCycle.selectGaps: Select the ingredient gaps you have reviewed.
kitchenCycle.previewFirst: Preview these exact choices before saving.
kitchenCycle.saveMainFirst: Save the shared main before choosing it as your personal answer.
kitchenCycle.paused: Planning generation is paused. Existing periods remain available.
kitchenCycle.completeTimes: Choose every planning day and time.
kitchenCycle.adminSetup: A household administrator sets up the planning routine.
kitchenCycle.setupHint: Set the usual routine, then preview real dates before explicitly enabling planning Tasks. Changes here affect future periods.
kitchenCycle.enable: Enable planning Tasks for future periods
kitchenCycle.offsetHint: Choose each planning day and local time separately. Monthly numbered days clamp at month end; DST gaps move forward and folds use the earlier instant.
kitchenCycle.advancedHint: Existing meal plans hold diners, chooser, cooks, supervisors, chores, assignment strategies, time windows and rotations. Opening these controls does not reset them.
kitchenCycle.generationBlocked: Planning generation is blocked. Review the routine and timing.
kitchenCycle.ensureHint: Explicitly create an anchored period after setup. Kitchen checks existing meals and protected history before creating Tasks.
kitchenCycle.enableFirst: Save and enable the planning setup first.
kitchenCycle.no_current_demand_execution: Existing cooking work has no current meal demand. Review the Task manually.
kitchenCycle.disabled_execution: Cooking automation is disabled; existing cooking work still needs manual review.
kitchenCycle.frozen_execution: Started or completed cooking work is preserved.
kitchenCycle.manual_edit: An edited Shopping item is preserved.
kitchenCycle.newSides: New sides are available to select after this change is saved or approved.
kitchenCycle.familyPreset: Propose Friday choices, Saturday review, Sunday groceries
kitchenCycle.removed_shopping_row: A removed Shopping item needs review.
kitchenCycle.purchased_or_reconciled: Purchased food and Pantry history are retained.
kitchenCycle.manually_edited: An edited Shopping item needs review.
kitchenCycle.begun_meal_history: Groceries for a meal that has begun are retained.
kitchenCycle.additionsDeferred: Additional demand is deferred until this Shopping discrepancy is reviewed.
kitchenCycle.draftSidesFirst: Save side changes before editing your meal answer. New sides are selectable after the change is saved or approved.
kitchenCycle.ingredientHint: One ingredient per line: name | quantity. Leave empty only when you intend no automatic ingredients.
kitchenCycle.fullImpact: Review quantities, people and existing work before applying.
kitchenCycle.automaticPaused: Automatic confirmation is paused. You can still review this period manually and open existing outputs.
kitchenCycle.demandComparisonHint: Confirmed and proposed ingredient requirements. These are needed amounts, not additional Shopping items; purchases and preserved coverage can change the output.

pairedDisplay.familyNameHint: Shown in the shared display greeting. Leave blank for a generic household greeting.
